authoring_contract.attenuation_law: g = exact cell mean of exp(-depth/L), depth from the declared analysis-domain face (decaying through void and fluid alike); g = 1 without attenuation
authoring_contract.attenuation_face_diagnostic: attenuation_face_occupancy: mean occupancy of the cell layer on the attenuation face per step; heating that should enter at a material surface is represented only where it is near one

responses.prescribed_volumetric_heating_final_W: whole-domain power at the final host time
responses.prescribed_volumetric_heating_energy_J: sum over post-initial host steps of P_n (t_n - t_{n-1}): the backward-Euler endpoint integral the host thermal history uses

limitations: Prescribed power densities: no radiation transport, spectrum, secondary-particle or geometry-dependent flux computation; the authored data must already represent the local deposition.

Optional attenuation is one exponential in depth from one declared analysis-domain face (the box face, not the material surface), integrated exactly over each cell; it decays through void and fluid cells exactly as through solid, and the e-folding length is fixed and not recomputed from the local material mix. It represents a heated material surface only where the face layer is solid: the diagnostics report the occupancy of the cell layer on the attenuation face.
No temperature, burn-up, activation or decay-heat feedback; any time dependence is the authored time factor.
Heating is attributed by physical occupancy: solid endmembers by occupancy times their phase fractions, the fluid by the complementary fraction; the numerical fluid-fraction floor carries no heating.

study_template_text.label: Configure prescribed volumetric heating (zero-load starter)
study_template_text.description: Enter a power density per solid endmember and for the fluid in W/m³, a time factor per time node and optionally an exponential depth attenuation from one domain face. Initial values produce zero heating. Authored bulk heat must exclude this contribution.
